_readme: Hand-added code in the three files scripts/extract-mockup.mjs OWNS (markup.html, style.css, main.js) that its mockup does not have. This registry is the RECORD half of gh#212, not the refusal half: what stops data loss is the extractor refusing to overwrite any file it already ships whose bytes would change, whether or not anybody wrote it down here. What this file adds is why a divergence is deliberate and who owns it (owner ruling 2026-09-05), and one power the file-level refusal does not have — a fragment listed here cannot be released by --force at all, only by editing this file, so releasing it is a reviewed diff. scripts/mockup-divergence-check.mjs also reds if a recorded fragment has already gone from the shipped tree. The mockups stay the original design record and are never edited to match. deliberate=false records a divergence nobody has ruled on yet and is NOT enforced. Enumerate the full drift, one line per mockup/route pair, with: node scripts/mockup-divergence-check.mjs --enumerate
